confirm.message: This will reclassify households and individuals in {districtName} using the stored PMT score and cutoff {cutoff}, and auto-enrol the POOR households in PCT. Continue?
confirm.messageAll: This will reclassify every household and individual in the database using the stored PMT score and cutoff {cutoff}, and auto-enrol the POOR households in PCT. Continue?

adjustment.showAdvancedOptions: Advanced options (limit to a region or district)
adjustment.infoAll: Applies the new cutoff to every household in the database: each household and its members are reclassified from their stored PMT score (no scores are recalculated), then newly POOR households are auto-enrolled in PCT. Suspended or graduated PCT beneficiaries are left unchanged. PMT Adjustment Result is updated when it finishes.
adjustment.infoScoped: Applies the new cutoff only to the selected region / district: households and members there are reclassified from their stored PMT score, then newly POOR households are auto-enrolled in PCT. Suspended or graduated PCT beneficiaries are left unchanged.
adjustment.formulaWarning: The global PMT formula still uses cutoff {formulaCutoff}: newly imported households will be classified with it. Change it on the Formula & Parameters tab (needs approval) if this new cutoff should apply to imports too.
